verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform with API reference pages (Integration Monitoring, Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs), so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no such spec: probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt and markdown docs exist but are documentation indexes, not machine-readable API specs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
